roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to both staff excellence and patient safety within a supportive environment.

In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, ensuring our team remains at the forefront of clinical best practices. Concurrently, you will lead our infection prevention and control initiatives, safeguarding the health and well-being of our residents and staff. Your expertise will be crucial in maintaining regulatory compliance and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42. We are looking for a proactive professional ready to make an immediate impact.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Maryland.
Proven experience in staff development, education, or clinical instruction.
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices within a healthcare setting.
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations pertaining to long-term care, staff education, and infection control.
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.

description: Are you an accomplished and results-driven Marketing Director seeking a confidential opportunity to make a significant impact? description:
We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Physical Therapist (PT) for a Per Diem (PRN) opportunity at a leading rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This role offers the flexibility to manage your schedule while providing essential therapy services to patients in a supportive environment. Join a team committed to patient recovery and well-being.

As a PRN Physical Therapist, you will be responsible for assessing, planning, and implementing individualized treatment programs to help patients regain function and improve their quality of life. You will work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team, utilizing your expertise in therapeutic exercises, manual therapy, and other modalities to achieve optimal patient outcomes.

This position offers a competitive hourly rate, providing an excellent opportunity for Physical Therapists looking for flexible work arrangements. Make a significant impact on the lives of patients recovering from various conditions, contributing to their journey towards independence and improved health.
requirements: Current and valid Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting preferred
Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team
Excellent communication and documentation abilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate ranging from $39.00 to $40.00, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN role offers flexibility while allowing you to make a significant impact on patients' lives by assisting them in their journey to recovery and improved mobility.

As a PTA, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, implementing treatment plans and providing therapeutic exercises to help patients regain function and reduce pain. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a supportive team environment and deliver high-quality care.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program
Current state licensure as a Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA)
CPR certification
Ability to work effectively in a rehabilitation setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00 based on experience.

description:
